import Foundation

let width = 1

actor Counter {
  var active = 0
  var peak = 0
  var completed = 0
  func enter() { active += 1; peak = max(peak, active) }
  func leave() { active -= 1; completed += 1 }
}

func mapWithConcurrency(
  items: [Int], width: Int, operation: @escaping @Sendable (Int) async throws -> Void
) async throws {
  for offset in stride(from: 0, to: items.count, by: width) {
    try await withThrowingTaskGroup(of: Void.self) { group in
      for item in items[offset..<min(offset + width, items.count)] {
        group.addTask { try await operation(item) }
      }
      try await group.waitForAll()
    }
  }
}

struct Importer {
  let width: Int
  func run(_ items: [Int], _ operation: @escaping @Sendable (Int) async throws -> Void) async throws {
    try await mapWithConcurrency(items: items, width: width, operation: operation)
  }
}

let counter = Counter()
let semaphore = DispatchSemaphore(value: 0)
Task {
  try await Importer(width: 4).run(Array(0..<8)) { _ in
    await counter.enter()
    try await Task.sleep(nanoseconds: 20_000_000)
    await counter.leave()
  }
  let peak = await counter.peak
  let completed = await counter.completed
  print("{\"serialDefault\":\(width),\"peak\":\(peak),\"completed\":\(completed)}")
  semaphore.signal()
}
semaphore.wait()
